evidence: Bosser 2015 distinguishes logical addresses from physical addresses and states that manufacturer-provided scrambling/interleaving knowledge is required to create physical bitmaps.

LELAPE 2024 states that the relevant Infineon SRAM campaigns used proprietary unscrambling/interleaving information to map logical addresses to physical bitcell locations in the XY plane and then applied MD-based clustering.
Zenodo states its MCU data were determined using the cited clustering procedure.
xadd_yadd_semantics: UNDOCUMENTED_ANCHOR_FIELDS; empirical equality to xmin/ymin is reported but no stronger label is assigned
hard_rule: Offsets are analyzed in supplied transformed XY grid only. x/y are never relabeled physical row/column, and the proprietary transform is not reconstructed.
